_comment: Pre-score filter. Edit here or in the app (Filtered -> Rules). Re-read at the start of every pipeline run and after Resume. Keywords are case-insensitive whole-word matches (a trailing 's' is allowed). Bias: when unsure, let the job through.

title._comment: An include hit overrides excludes and skips the LLM check (goes straight to full scoring).

location._comment: Dropped only when the job is NOT remote and the location mentions one of these.

salary._comment: Drop only when a listed MAX converts below the floor. Missing or ambiguous salary never drops. Update rates occasionally.

description._comment: hardDropPhrases drop. flagPhrases never drop; they are shown to the LLM check as hints.
flagPhrases: five days a week in office

llm._comment: Cheap batched title check on jobs the rules did not decide. drop = filtered; keep/maybe = full scoring. model null = use the scoring model.
llm.targetRoles: Product Manager, Associate Product Manager, Product Operations, Product Strategy, Growth Manager, Growth Strategy, Go-to-Market Strategy, BizOps / Business Operations, Strategy and Operations, Product-Led Growth. Locations: fully remote in Canada, or hybrid in Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario. Industries: tech, SaaS, fintech, health tech. Best fit: roles mixing strategy with hands-on execution ownership, zero-to-one building, fast-moving AI-forward teams.
llm.hardPasses: Sales-heavy roles (quota, commission, SDR/BDR, account executive); marketing execution (SEO, email, demand gen, content, social); agency or client-services studios; project management; pure operations roles with no strategy component (facilities, logistics, sports or event operations); roles requiring a regular Toronto commute; anything outside business and product functions (trades, clinical, legal, retail, hospitality, marine, software engineering).
